scope: London Square war memorial: obelisk, two colonnades and their chamber exteriors. No interior memorials, names, trees or surrounding buildings.
reference_state: Post-2008 architectural/paved setting; broad stone condition chiefly follows dated 2009–2013 photographs. SW WWII insert follows the supplied Instagram photograph, published 2026-10-03 but captured on an unknown date. Live 2018 Street View and 2019 Mapillary views corroborate the ensemble. This documented composite reference state is not a claim of exact condition on a single day.

resolved_conflicts: IWM mont_8 and mont_8a captions reverse the two south-east ends. Follow HE and IWM prose: THEY DIED on NE, REMEMBER on SW. WMO Southport_2 also confirms REMEMBER at SW colonnade.
SW panel says THOSE BRAVE MEN in photograph, despite one transcription giving THESE.
IWM compass directions simplified; use true NE/SW buildings and NW/SE ends per HE and map.
NE NW chamber end has the pelta trophy, while its NE garden-facing window has the winged-Victory medallion. Do not repeat a chamber-end motif over every window.

The supplied Instagram carousel photograph 3 clearly shows a legible WWII insert; HE locates it on SW. This supersedes the prior blank-roundel interpretation based on the IWM erased-inscription caption. Photograph capture date and chronology of any removal/reinstatement remain unknown; NE stays plain.

Art UK gives estimated 24.40 x 5.10 x 7.00 m for a colonnade; retain IWM 24.60 x 4.90 x 5.54 m because its height is more consistent with reviewed photographs. No common measurement datum is established.

figure_surface_method: Continuous relief surfaces: traced silhouettes and authored depth layers, bounded 7–8 mm single-view shading-gradient residual for fine carving, explicitly incised PATRIA; depths remain estimated, not photogrammetry.

traced_exterior_reliefs.figures: Continuous hand-traced depth layers from centenary-03, cross-checked against IWM
traced_exterior_reliefs.torches: IWM mont_8a; 0.94 x 0.84 m numeric field, estimated depths up to 61 mm, source shading residual bounded before 0.70 depth scaling
traced_exterior_reliefs.wreath_trophy: IWM mont_13a; 2.0 x 0.55 m numeric field, estimated depths up to 59 mm, source shading residual bounded before 0.75 depth scaling
traced_exterior_reliefs.warning: Single-view interpretation, not a measured scan. No source colour included. Local variations and erosion between repeated panels are not reconstructed.
traced_exterior_reliefs.pelta_trophy: IWM mont_13; 2.0 x 0.52 m field with lion terminals, straps, palmette, weapons, palm fronds and braziers; estimated maximum depth 60 mm
traced_exterior_reliefs.victory_trophy: IWM mont_13b; 2.0 x 0.52 m field with winged Victory, open helmet notches, floral swags, torches, palm and trumpet; estimated maximum depth 47 mm
traced_exterior_reliefs.southport_arms: IWM mont_3a; 1.30 m square numeric field buried into the pedestal; separate existing roundel mouldings; 11 glyphs incised 3.5 mm along the ribbon. Estimated relief depth about 35 mm.
traced_exterior_reliefs.salute_wreath: IWM mont_1a; two traced branches with 63 pointed leaves and an inner moulding, 1.34 m numeric canvas. Estimated maximum depth 23 mm; mortar beds cut consistently with pedestal. No inferred ribbon blocks.

frieze.confidence: Photo-derived outline; dimensions and depth estimated

rosettes.confidence: Twelve flared petals supported by IWM mont_8a; repeated design at other ends and windows inferred

exterior_flora.settings: Window band 2.30 x 0.22 m, rosettes aligned to separately capped jambs at ±0.71 m. End band 2.32 x 0.22 m; photographic dimensions estimated.
exterior_flora.limits: Individual erosion, very small carved veins and exact chamber-frame geometry remain unresolved

pedestal_coursework.method: Shallow channels in pedestal, matching physical gaps in roundel borders and numeric arms; shared horizontal levels on four faces
pedestal_coursework.limits: SE/NW photographed vertical bonds only; NE/SW vertical bonds unresolved; course scale and 4 mm width / 3 mm depth estimated
pedestal_coursework.salute_underline: Single 90 x 6 mm dash, now positioned from the source image above the lower visible mortar bed

salute_lettering_layout.method: Approximate visible glyph bounds registered with the same masonry beds as the wreath; fit serif font to each line bounding rectangle
salute_lettering_layout.limits: Roman serif font approximates original letter shapes. Full stops after MUTE and SALUTE are visible. The mark above/right of UPWARD is ambiguous and is not transcribed as punctuation. The short underline retains estimated 90 x 6 mm dimensions.

obelisk_fixtures.geometry: Solid pyramid with real recessed openings, inset shared grille meshes and separate shared linear housing mesh with two support feet per face
obelisk_fixtures.limits: Fixture and pyramid dimensions, grille spacing and cross sections estimated. NE arrangement unverified. No internal electrical or optical design claimed. Shaft coursework is now registered separately in shaft_masonry_calibration.json.

shaft_masonry.method: Photo-registered horizontal levels and separately traced bonds, with closed stone faces over a solid tapered backing. Estimated seams are 3 mm wide and 4 mm deep.
shaft_masonry.limits: Conditional photographic fit; registration spread about 0.12 m within the assumed envelope, not a bound on absolute dimensional error. Lateral bond picks are approximate to 0.04 m. Topmost band vertical streaks are unresolved. Surface aging remains pending.

obelisk_surfaces.shaft: Three authored metric surface classes with 11 pale landmarks and 12 pitted blocks; remaining blocks use a general aged class
obelisk_surfaces.pyramid: SE/SW yellow and NW grey-green central streaks; NE kept generic because a close reference is lacking
obelisk_surfaces.method: Procedural numeric fields and bounded pit profiles; normal/roughness maps and base colour export as embedded PBR images; source photographs are not embedded
obelisk_surfaces.reference_condition: Close surface details follow 2011–2013 photographs; present-day condition has not been verified
obelisk_surfaces.limits: Fine shapes and absolute albedo/roughness/depth are interpreted, not measured; weathering of the colonnades and pedestal remains generic

colonnade_plan.confidence: Photographic estimate: repeated cornice pairs support 3.0 m pitch conditional on square 4.4 m chambers; pitch roughly +/-0.15 m. Roof setback and pier dimensions estimated.

ground_and_bases.confidence: Photographic estimate; ground datum ±0.12 m and gradient ±0.008

colonnade_pedestal_weathering.method: Authored broad vertex-colour multiplier over portable stone maps
colonnade_pedestal_weathering.evidence: Darker lower stone and sheltered cornice/parapet streaking in saved photographs
colonnade_pedestal_weathering.limits: Exact marks, hue/intensity and present-day condition unverified; repeated details share patina
